law_fields.force: directive-binding for the charge; declarative-naming for the lot's name
law_fields.consequence: the spoken form binds and the stamp-holder enters the act on the stamp-roll; the lot's name is written on the ingot's tally face

law_fields.speaker: stamp-holder only — no master, no delegate
law_fields.holder: none — the register admits no binding oath
law_fields.consequence: an oath spoken in stamp is void; the binding oath is plain speech (L-30 gis, the plain mark-axis oath word), so a stamp oath carries no entry on the stamp-roll
